predictions.articleTitle: Bolton vs West Brom Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Porous Home Defense Hold? — xG & Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: West Brom's superior xG creation and second-half scoring surge against Bolton's 2.00 xGA defense favor Draw / Away Win alongside Over 2.5 goals and BTTS: Yes.

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Porous Bolton home defense tests West Brom's unbeaten Championship run

spf.comment: Covers both the leading 1:2 West Brom second-half victory script and the 1:1 draw branch, as a single away call carries excess risk given West Brom's recent draws and Isaac Price's fitness doubt.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 3.18 combined lambda, 61.6% Over 2.5 model probability, and 62.5% Over 2.5 rates across both teams' home/away splits.

btts.comment: Backed by a 63.3% BTTS model probability, 75.0% venue-split BTTS rates for both sides, and confirmed absences of holding midfielders Erhahon and Diakite.

score.comment: 1:2 aligns with West Brom's 1.76 away lambda against Bolton's 2.00 xGA defense, while 1:1 covers the top Poisson cell if West Brom's doubtful scorers sit out.

goals.comment: 3 goals (22.3%) and 2 goals (21.5%) represent the two highest-density Poisson outcomes matching the 1:2 and 1:1 scripts.

bqc.comment: West Brom have drawn at half-time in 7 of 8 away games while scoring 66.7% of away goals after the break, pointing to a level interval followed by either an away win or stalemate.
